opinions.rationale: Inverted-prior search did not turn up an outcome-blind procedure that selects the time-grid width or grace-period length from treatment and observation processes alone and reports how far the estimate moves under alternatives. The report's own core citation, Tankpinou Zoumenou et al. (arXiv:2603.15924, 2026), formalizes when partitioning is too fine or too coarse via structural causal models, shows that clone-censor-weight can fail when treatment affects outcome inside a period, and recommends clinical specification of partitioning rather than defaulting to data resolution. That is design guidance and a validity check, not an algorithmic, outcome-masked selector. Wanis et al. (JRSS-A 2024; arXiv:2212.11398) formalizes natural versus stochastic grace-period strategies (how treatment is distributed during a grace window) and leaves window length as a protocol input. Ferreira Guerra et al. (Stat Med 2020) and Adams, Saria, and Rosenblum (arXiv:2011.15099) quantify estimation consequences of timeline discretization; they do not choose the grid without outcome use. Continuous-time MSMs and marked-point-process weights (Ryalen/Røysland line; Kalia et al., Stat Med 2025) reduce dependence on an arbitrary binning for some sustained-treatment estimands, but they do not select a grace period, do not fix the eligibility–assignment–follow-up triad for clone or sequential emulations, and do not ship a grid-invariance diagnostic. TARGET (JAMA 2025), HARPER/STaRT-RWE-style protocol templates, and Fu et al. (BMJ 2026) require reporting interval width and grace period and teach alignment; none supply a data-only selection rule. Applied emulations often vary grace period in one-off sensitivity analyses (for example six versus twelve months); that is ad hoc robustness, not outcome-blind primary selection plus a multiverse movement measure. CRAN/GitHub surfaces for TrialEmulation, gfoRmula, gfoRmulaICE, lmtp, ltmle, concrete, CICI, WeightIt, ipw, adjustedCurves, riskRegression, zEpid, and related tools treat interval unit and grace length as user arguments, with no merged PR implementing outcome-masked grid or grace selection. Queries covered the problem's prior_work list; grace-period/time-grid/partitioning terms in AJE, Epidemiology, IJE, EJE, JCE, PDS, Stat Med, Biometrics/Biostatistics, BMJ/JAMA family, 2024–2026; arXiv stat.ME and medRxiv; multiverse/specification-curve + grace or time-zero; continuous-time MSM/g-computation; visit-intensity or observation-process interval selection; and package activity. Proposal, formalization, and sensitivity practice leave the stated gap open.
